title: Registry gate allowed programmatic external navigation

before_fix: location.replace(destination) returned pass when destination was unresolved
after_fix: Dynamic or unresolved assign/replace destinations fail the source-isolation gate
Remote and unresolved location.href writes fail the source-isolation gate
Reflect.apply, Reflect.set, Object.defineProperty, and Object.assign navigation paths fail closed
Fragment-only location changes and explicit external anchor links remain allowed
reproduction.red_before_fix: The new registry-gate cases failed before implementation; they pass after the fix.

root_cause: The scanner rejected executable and active-document URL schemes but treated ordinary HTTPS and unresolved programmatic navigation as safe. The preview permits scripts in an opaque sandbox and connect-src does not restrict navigation.
remediation: Reject unresolved or non-fragment programmatic navigation. Preserve ordinary external anchors so the user explicitly activates navigation.

local_validation.registry_gate_cli_black_box: 17/17 passed; a valid Button resource with window.location.assign(destination) returns a rejected JSON report and nonzero process status
local_validation.full_unit_suite: 1198 passed across 76 files, including the new CLI black-box regression
local_validation.preview_csp_browser_suite: 18/18 passed across desktop and mobile Chromium
local_validation.audit_all: passed all 16 behavioral gates, production build, bundle budgets, provenance, secrets/security, and dependency checks

deployed_verification: pending release-candidate deployment and hostile-preview navigation recheck

browser_runtime_probe.runtime: Local Sites Worker preview at the current workspace build; not the deployed public Site.

embedded_preview.result: Parent app-shell frame-src blocked navigation before a request was emitted.
embedded_preview.console: Expected CSP frame-src violation from the deliberately injected security probe.

top_level_preview.result: Playwright route interception aborted the dummy request with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT before network access; the preview tab then displayed chrome-error.

browser_runtime_probe.csp_navigation_directive: An exploratory navigate-to none header was reported as an unrecognized directive by Chromium and did not block the attempted navigation.
